q: What does the teacher say when the student arrives?

context.title: 请进
lines: 学生：老师，您好！  (Hello, teacher!)
老师：你好！请进。  (Hello! Please come in.)
学生：谢谢老师。  (Thank you, teacher.)
老师：不客气。请坐。  (You're welcome. Please sit down.)
学生：对不起，老师！  (Sorry, teacher!)
老师：没关系。  (It's okay.)

why: The teacher's first line is 你好！请进。, so the teacher greets the student and invites them in.

not.再见！: 再见 is goodbye; the student has just arrived.
not.没关系。: 没关系 is the teacher's reply to 对不起, later on.
not.谢谢。: 谢谢 is what the student says, not the teacher.

q: What does the teacher say to the whole class?

lines: 老师：你们好！  (Hello, everyone!)

老师：请读一下。  (Please read it.)
学生：你好，您好，你们好。  (Nǐ hǎo, nín hǎo, nǐmen hǎo.)
老师：很好！请再说一遍。  (Very good! Please say it again.)
学生：老师，我会写“你好”。  (Teacher, I can write “nǐ hǎo”.)
老师：好，请写。  (Good, please write it.)

why: The teacher opens with 你们好！; 你们 means 'you' for several people, so it is for the whole class.

not.您好！: 您好 is polite 'you' for one person, not a class.
not.再见！: 再见 is goodbye; the lesson is just starting.
not.请坐！: The teacher does not say 请坐 in this text.

lines: A：这件白衬衣是真丝的吗？  (Is this white shirt real silk?)
B：是，又凉快又舒服。  (Yes — cool and comfortable.)
A：有黑的吗？  (Do you have it in black?)
B：有。我给您一张优惠券。  (Yes. I'll give you a coupon.)

why: A asks 有黑的吗？; 黑 means black.

not.White: 白 is the colour the shirt already is.
not.Red: 红 is not mentioned in this text.
not.Blue: 蓝 is not mentioned in this text.

not.三千块: She says 两千, not 三千.

context.title: 去邮局怎么走
lines: A：请问，去邮局怎么走？  (Excuse me, how do I get to the post office?)
B：一直往前走，到十字路口往左拐。  (Go straight, then turn left at the crossroads.)
A：离这儿远吗？  (Is it far from here?)
B：不远，三百多米。  (No, a little over 300 metres.)

why: B says 到十字路口往左拐; 往左拐 means turn left.

not.Right: 往右拐 is right; B says 往左拐.
not.Straight: B says to go straight first, then turn left at the crossroads.
not.Back: B does not say to go back.

q: How far is the post office?

context.title: 去邮局怎么走
lines: A：请问，去邮局怎么走？  (Excuse me, how do I get to the post office?)
B：一直往前走，到十字路口往左拐。  (Go straight, then turn left at the crossroads.)
A：离这儿远吗？  (Is it far from here?)
B：不远，三百多米。  (No, a little over 300 metres.)

why: B says 三百多米: three hundred and some metres, a bit over 300 metres.

not.3 km: B says 米, metres, not kilometres.
not.30 m: 三十 is 30; B says 三百.
not.3,000 m: 三千 is 3,000; B says 三百多.
